## Scrap Paper - Show Work

Press the ✏️ icon to draw on the screen

Press <span class="keycap"><span class="keycap-top">~</span><span class="keycap-main">`</span></span> (just press it, no Shift) to open R

## Z-Table Reminder

::: callout-tip
## The table gives the area to the **left** of z

- **Left of z:** read the table value directly.
- **Right of z:** 1 minus the table value.
- **Between two z's:** big area minus small area.
:::
